chunks.ar: تحكي رواية قديمة أن الخليفة المأمون وصل إلى مصر،
chunks.en_old: An old tale says Caliph al-Maamun visited Egypt
chunks.en_new: An old tale says Caliph al-Maamun visited Egypt

chunks.ar: وشاهد الأهرامات العظيمة، فدهش من ضخامة أحجارها وارتفاعها.
chunks.en_old: and marveled at the pyramids.
chunks.en_new: and saw the great pyramids, amazed at the size and height of their stones.
chunks.note: omitted size and height of stones

chunks.ar: سمع أن الناس يتحدثون عن كنوز مخبأة داخلها،
chunks.en_old: Hearing rumors of hidden treasure,
chunks.en_new: He heard people talk of treasures hidden inside them,

chunks.ar: فأراد أن يعرف ما تخفيه.
chunks.en_old: he wanted to discover what lay inside.
chunks.en_new: he wanted to discover what lay inside.

chunks.ar: قرر المأمون فتح أحد الأهرامات،
chunks.en_old: Al-Maamun ordered workers to open a pyramid
chunks.en_new: Al-Maamun decided to open one of the pyramids,

chunks.ar: بل حاول إزالة جزء كبير منه. جمع العمال وأمرهم بالحفر،
chunks.en_old: and even tried to take part of it down.
chunks.en_new: and even tried to remove a large part of it. He gathered workers and ordered them to dig,

chunks.ar: لكن الحجارة الضخمة قاومت أدواتهم، وكان العمل أبطأ وأصعب مما توقع الجميع في البداية.
chunks.en_old: Its enormous stones resisted their tools.
chunks.en_new: but the huge stones resisted their tools, and the work was slower and harder than anyone first expected.

chunks.ar: استمر العمل أيامًا كثيرة، وأنفق الخليفة مبالغ ضخمة على الرجال والأدوات ونقل الحجارة.
chunks.en_old: Work continued at great cost,
chunks.en_new: The work went on for many days, and the caliph spent huge sums on men, tools and moving stones.

chunks.ar: ومع ذلك لم يتمكن العمال إلا من فتح نفق صغير في جسم الهرم،
chunks.en_old: but the laborers managed to open only a small tunnel.
chunks.en_new: Yet the workers managed to open only a small tunnel in the body of the pyramid,

chunks.ar: ولم يظهر لهم ما كانوا يتوقعونه.
chunks.en_old: The expected riches did not readily appear.
chunks.en_new: and they did not find what they had expected.

chunks.ar: ثم وجدوا، كما تقول الحكاية، مالًا وكنوزًا داخل الممر.
chunks.en_old: Eventually, the story says, treasure was found.
chunks.en_new: Then, as the tale says, they found money and treasures inside the passage.

chunks.ar: أمر المأمون بحساب قيمتها ومقارنتها بما دفعه للحفر،
chunks.en_old: Its value matched exactly what the caliph had spent
chunks.en_new: Al-Maamun ordered their value counted and compared with what he had paid for the digging,

chunks.ar: فكانت المفاجأة أن القيمة ساوت نفقات العمل تمامًا، لا أكثر ولا أقل.
chunks.en_old: on excavation—no more and no less.
chunks.en_new: and to everyone's surprise the value equaled the cost of the work exactly, no more and no less.

chunks.ar: تعجب الخليفة من هذا الاتفاق الغريب، وأدرك أنه لم يربح شيئًا من محاولته المكلفة.
chunks.en_old: Astonished by the coincidence and his lack of profit,
chunks.en_new: The caliph marveled at this strange coincidence and realized he had gained nothing from his costly attempt.

chunks.ar: أخذ ما وجده،
chunks.en_old: the caliph took what had been discovered
chunks.en_new: He took what he had found,

chunks.ar: ثم ترك فكرة هدم الأهرامات، وأمر بوقف العمل والعودة إلى شؤون الحكم الأخرى.
chunks.en_old: and abandoned his attempt to dismantle the pyramids.
chunks.en_new: then gave up the idea of tearing down the pyramids, ordered the work stopped, and returned to other affairs of state.
chunks.note: omitted stopping work, return to rule

chunks.ar: تواصل الرواية وصف الأهرامات بأنها من عجائب الدنيا،
chunks.en_old: The tale describes the pyramids as wonders
chunks.en_new: The tale goes on to describe the pyramids as wonders of the world,

chunks.ar: مبنية من أحجار عظيمة وضعت بدقة فوق بعضها.
chunks.en_old: built from immense, carefully fitted stones,
chunks.en_new: built from immense, carefully fitted stones,

chunks.ar: وتتحدث عن حديد ورصاص استعملا في البناء، وعن ممرات وغرف لا يعرف الناس أسرارها.
chunks.en_old: and imagines mysterious passages and chambers within them.
chunks.en_new: It speaks of iron and lead used in the building, and of passages and rooms whose secrets no one knows.

chunks.ar: ويزعم الرواة القدماء أن بعض الغرف تضم جواهر وأسلحة وكتبًا،
chunks.en_old: Ancient storytellers imagined jewels, weapons, writings
chunks.en_new: Ancient storytellers claim that some rooms hold jewels, weapons and books,

chunks.ar: وأن حراسًا خفيين يحفظونها من الزمان.
chunks.en_old: and unseen guardians inside.
chunks.en_new: and that hidden guards protect them from time.

chunks.ar: هذه أوصاف أسطورية وردت في القصة،
chunks.en_old: These are legendary claims,
chunks.en_new: These are legendary descriptions found in the story,

chunks.ar: وليست معلومات مؤكدة عن تاريخ الأهرامات الحقيقي.
chunks.en_old: not established facts about the pyramids.
chunks.en_new: not confirmed facts about the real history of the pyramids.

chunks.ar: وتنتهي الحكاية بالتأمل في الآثار التي بقيت بعدما اختفى أصحابها.
chunks.en_old: The tale closes by reflecting on monuments that outlast their builders.
chunks.en_new: The tale ends by reflecting on the monuments that remained after their owners vanished.

chunks.ar: فقد رحل الملوك والبناؤون، وظلت الأهرامات تشهد على زمن بعيد،
chunks.en_old: Kings passed away, pyramids endured,
chunks.en_new: The kings and builders passed away, and the pyramids still bear witness to a distant age,
chunks.note: omitted builders, witness to a distant age

chunks.ar: بينما توقف المأمون عن البحث عن ربح تحت حجارتها.
chunks.en_old: and al-Maamun stopped seeking profit beneath their stones.
chunks.en_new: while al-Maamun stopped seeking profit beneath their stones.
